executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Use the seeded admin credentials for login flows: email admin@eventmanager.com and password admin1234. The frontend is running at http://localhost:4000 and the backend API at http://localhost:3000/api via Docker Compose. Prefer deterministic flows that create their own event and guest data before testing guest, QR, check-in, and media workflows. Avoid relying on physical camera permissions for QR scanning; use manual check-in or API-backed deterministic paths where necessary.
